card.name: Hedges before 'check with your advisor'
card.fires_on: Linking or hedging words (so, as, per, please, should, a period) right where the text is about to say details vary and to consult or follow a specific person or source.

modes.label: Variation then consult
modes.description: A word like 'so' or 'Please' after a note that rules or options differ, leading into advice to check with someone.
modes.example: There are other styles in use as well,<< so>> do check with your tutors as to which

modes.label: Dose qualifiers
modes.description: Words like 'as', 'or as', or 'should' in dose text just before 'as directed' or 'adjusted according to' the individual case.
modes.example: paying special attention to the edges of the nail, cuticles and skin around the nails or<< as>> directed by a doctor

card.writes: It promotes words meaning 'specific' or 'details' (in Chinese) and 'consult', pushing the text toward 'consult for specifics'.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before a phrase like 'as directed' or 'check with your provider for specifics'.
